iterations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a SINGLE FRONT VIEW of Kaiming, SHJ-039, an attractive youthful male yokai aged about 22, one torso with NINE living human heads. This is ONE character, ONE view, NOT a two-view sheet. Transparent background.
Image 1 and image 2 are the direct production drawing-style references: match their simple expressive anime faces, near-black variable-width ink contours, sparse internal lines, warm peach skin, flat matte colors and clean hard-edged cel shadows. Simple dark hair blocks, flat olive iris with pure black pupil, no eye highlights or iris texture. No goggles. Do not copy their clothing or identity.
Anatomy is the most important requirement: exactly NINE distinct human-faced heads, all complete and visible. One main central head on its normal human neck. FOUR smaller heads to the viewer's left and FOUR to the viewer's right. The eight secondary heads grow from eight separate living tiger-striped neck branches that emerge directly from the same upper back and shoulders. Organically connected anatomy, not floating heads, masks, badges or ghosts.
Arrange those eight heads in FOUR distinct symmetrical PAIRS in an expansive fan around the central head: the highest pair above and outside the main head, the second pair farther outward at temple height, the third pair farther outward at shoulder height, and the fourth/lowest pair farthest outward just above the elbows. Give each pair its own clear level and enough blank space that all FOUR faces on each side are individually countable. There must be FOUR on the left, FOUR on the right and ONE center = NINE heads. Every neck is physically connected down to the one torso. Do NOT combine the third and fourth pairs. Do NOT reuse the old seven-head composition.
Identity: handsome slim youthful man; short near-black charcoal hair, sharp lively brows, olive eyes and an assertive open mouth showing one small white tooth shape. Other heads carry alert expressions of the same young identity. Warm peach human faces; the exposed neck branches and two normal human arms have warm ochre tiger markings drawn as sparse bold dark shapes. No wrinkles, beard, broad old body or animal faces. Exactly two normal arms held calmly down, cropped at mid-thigh. Cream sleeveless cross-collar tunic with dark navy edging, rust-red diagonal sash and waist belt. Hands and clothes have sparse linework.
Composition: centered front-facing entire nine-head fan and one slender torso, generous clear space around all hair tips. Wide canvas if needed; nine faces must stay readable, no cropping. All heads and necks are alive and attached to the shared body. No text, numbering, symbols, scenery, glow, mist, blur, gradients, painterly texture or light effects. True alpha-transparent background. Count the NINE heads before finishing.
reviewNotes: Nine complete youthful human faces are visible, but lowest left/right heads float without necks. Anatomy failed. Superseded by front R04b.
No manual pixel edits or cut-and-paste compositing performed.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 3, the SINGLE FRONT VIEW of the nine-headed youthful Kaiming boy. Images 1 and 2 are the direct production style reference.
Image 3 ALREADY contains exactly NINE human heads, correctly arranged as one central head, four to the viewer's left, four to the right. Preserve ALL NINE complete heads, all their positions, face identities, clothing, colors and current torso exactly. Do not delete or add a head.
One anatomy correction ONLY: the LOWEST LEFT HEAD and LOWEST RIGHT HEAD are currently floating detached from the torso. Draw TWO NEW LIVING TIGER-STRIPED NECKS to attach those two lowest heads organically to the SAME upper-back/shoulder-root system as the other heads. The new neck for the lowest left head must curve OUTWARD and DOWN from behind the left shoulder then attach to the underside of its jaw; the new neck for the lowest right head mirrors it. Use ample visible curved neck length across the empty space between each lowest head and torso. They must look like muscular live necks, warm ochre with sparse bold tiger stripes, NOT ropes, cloth, tentacles, necklaces or supporting props. Keep the two lowest faces entirely visible, no cropping or hiding. Keep every existing head/neck untouched. Nine heads on nine living necks connected to ONE shared youthful tiger-marked torso.
Keep true transparent alpha background. Keep near-black variable-width sparse contours, flat matte colors, hard-edged shadows, simple charcoal hair, warm peach human faces, flat olive irises black pupils with no highlights. Do not add scenery, glow, gradients, text or numbers. Only add those two missing organic neck connections; do not change the other anatomy or count.
reviewNotes: Manual visual count: central human face plus four complete faces down the left fan and four down the right fan = nine.

The two formerly floating lowest heads now have clearly visible live tiger-striped necks that run back to the shared shoulder/back root. All nine heads are organically connected to one youthful human torso.
Shallow hair shading and skin modulation remain more detailed than a literal flat production reference; this is a candidate with anatomy checked, not user approval.
Cream tunic, navy edging and rust-red waist sash match both new R04 views. The earlier diagonal shoulder sash is absent in R04 and is a documented wardrobe simplification.
Do not use initial front R04 as the final front asset.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a SINGLE THREE-QUARTER VIEW of the EXACT same nine-headed Kaiming youthful male yokai in image 3. This is ONE character, ONE view. Images 1 and 2 are direct production linework/flat-color style masters; image 3 is the exact approved-for-count anatomical and identity reference, not evidence of user approval.
Image 3 has exactly NINE living heads attached to one body: ONE central main head and FOUR secondary heads to each side. Preserve all nine heads and their eight tiger-striped branching necks. Change the body's viewing angle to 30-degree three-quarter, looking toward the viewer's right. Keep the head fan sufficiently spread that EVERY ONE of the NINE complete human faces and every neck connection is clearly visible. Foreshorten naturally, but do not hide any far-side head behind another head. Nine real human faces must remain independently countable. Do not merge or lose the lowest pair.
Anatomical arrangement: central large head, plus FOUR separate side-head pairs on four progressively lower/outward levels. Highest pair above main head; second pair at main temple level; third pair at shoulder level; fourth pair near elbows with visible curved living necks. All eight side heads are on muscular warm-ochre neck branches with sparse dark tiger stripes that originate in the same upper back and shoulder-root system. One shared slim human torso, two ordinary human arms. NO floating heads, masks, badges, pendants, ghosts, extra torsos or separate people. All nine faces are attractive young male human faces of the SAME identity, dark charcoal hair, warm peach skin and flat olive irises/pure black pupils with no highlights. The main mouth is assertively slightly open and the brows have alert tension. No old-face or heavy-muscular redesign.
Keep EXACT cream sleeveless cross-collar tunic, dark navy collar edging, rust-red waist sash and dark navy lower trim from image 3. Keep tiger markings on arms. Near-black variable-width outline, sparse internal lines, simple dark hair masses, very flat matte blocks, one hard-edged shadow color per surface. No glossy eyes, no painterly hair, no soft lighting.
Framing: single isolated waist-up/upper-thigh character, enough wide clear space for all NINE heads and necks, all hair outlines inside canvas with margin. The angle must clearly differ from the front image. Transparent alpha background, no text, numbers, scenery, cast shadow, glow, gradients or blur. Before finishing verify four heads left of central + four right of central + one central = NINE heads, all attached.
reviewNotes: Manual visual count: main angled human face plus four complete faces on either side = nine. The upper right branch passes behind the central hair but its neck and continuation to the shared root remain visible.
Main torso and main face visibly turn toward viewer-right, unlike the front asset. Side heads retain the four-tier fan and every face remains readable.
Same youthful dark-haired/olive-eyed identity, tiger-marked necks/arms, cream/navy tunic and rust-red waist sash as front R04b.
No further correction used: first three-quarter generation passed head count and attached anatomy check. Style remains candidate_pending_user_review.
